mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (historical easing threshold), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL above 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, triggering hawkish monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the current month's employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 4.0%), a rise in CPIAUCSL above 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals impending monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 > 2% and UNRATE < 4.0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL rise events, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the employment level (PAYEMS) relative to the prior month indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS declines from prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) relative to the prior month signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
